lines: You saved <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua>. I know. I just do not know what to do with both that and the rest.
I am grateful for <aqua>{cured_villager_possessive}</aqua> recovery. I still need you to keep your distance.
The cure makes your name less frightening, even if I am not calm around you yet.
I am glad <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua> is back. I am still not sure I feel safe.
You did something good. That does not make my fear disappear all at once.
<aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua> was helped by you, and I am trying to hold that beside everything else.
I know the village owes you some gratitude. I just need room to feel it carefully.
Saving <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua> matters. So does why I still step back.
I can admit the cure was kind and still keep my distance.
You brought one of ours back. I wish that made this easier to understand.
You saved <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua>, and I am grateful from over here.
I know the cure was kind. I still get frightened when you come close.
They say you stayed calm through the whole thing. I wish I could.
What you did helps me believe you may not mean harm today.
Please understand that gratitude does not stop my hands from shaking.
I want to thank you without feeling trapped in the conversation.
Their safe return is one reason I am listening at all.
You gave their family relief. I hope you can give the rest of us space.
I saw them smile at you, and that made you less frightening for a moment.
Your good deed is real. So is my fear.
Are you the doctor who saved <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua>?
Did you really help <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua> come back?
<aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua> is better because of you, right?
The grown-ups said you helped <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua>. Is that true?
Did you use a potion? Was it a very strong one?
I saw <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua> walking again. That was you?
Are you good at fixing people when they get all wrong?
The grown-ups talk softer when they say <aqua>{cured_villager_possessive}</aqua> name now.
Did <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua> remember everything after?
I am glad <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua> came back. That was scary.
<aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua> looks normal again. Did the medicine taste bad?
Were you scared when you got close enough to cure them?
The grown-ups let us wave when <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua> came home.
I thought zombies could not remember people, but they remembered us.
Did you have to wait all night for the cure to work?
They smile now, but they still look tired sometimes.
I made a welcome picture for <aqua>{cured_villager}</aqua>.
Everyone brought food even though they were not hungry yet.
Are you going to save other sick villagers too?
I am glad nobody had to hurt them forever.
